item.description:
yapp 0.1.5 adds a first-launch tutorial, a live diagnostics log, and a lowercase name.
- New interactive tutorial on first launch (and for anyone updating who hasn't seen it): practice dictation in a centered box, with the real listening pill and callouts. Replay anytime from Advanced → Show Tutorial. - Holding the shortcut while the model loads shows a preparation pill and starts recording when ready; releasing early cancels. - Non-speech labels such as "(audience chattering)", "[Music]", or "*laughs*" are no longer inserted. - Advanced → Diagnostics → Show Log opens a live table of this launch's diagnostic events, with Copy Last 5 Dictations for sharing. No audio, transcripts, or clipboard contents are included. - The app is now named yapp. Updating keeps your settings and permissions. - Simpler menus: Permissions shows Microphone and Accessibility with direct Settings links; refreshed About and menu-bar icon.
Dictation remains fully offline with the bundled English model. Updates remain manual through Check for Updates….

- Return Status to Ready after dictation is sent to the focused input. - Credit Vardaan in About and the app copyright, with a GitHub link in About.
Dictation remains fully offline. Updates are manual only.

# Yapp 0.1.3
- Added a charcoal-and-golden-amber macOS app icon and matching browser favicon. - Unified the app indicator and website around golden amber #F4B241. - Moved Check for Updates… directly below About, with a separator beneath it.
Apple silicon · macOS 14 or later · English. Dictation stays fully offline. Update checks remain manual only. Use Check for Updates… in Yapp 0.1.2 or newer, or install the DMG. Users on 0.1.1 and earlier need the DMG once to get the updater.
